title: Space Weather Prediction Center message
description: A NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center text product in the layout of the live messages: space weather message code, serial number and UTC issue time, then the product kind (watch, warning, alert or summary), the headline, the level by day or the threshold details, the NOAA scale and the potential impacts. Covers geomagnetic storm (K-index), X-ray flux and proton event messages. Codes and times are exact; an exercise product is marked as one.

messageCode.description: The SWPC space weather message code, copied from the live product family (geomagnetic watches WATA20 for G1, WATA30 for G2, WATA50 for G3 and WATA99 for G4 or greater; K-index warnings WARK04 to WARK07, where WARK07 means 7 or greater; K-index alerts ALTK04 to ALTK09; WARSUD and SUMSUD for a sudden impulse; ALTXMF X-ray alert and SUMXM5, SUMX01, SUMX10, SUMX20 X-ray summaries; WARPX1, ALTPX1 to ALTPX5 and SUMPX1 to SUMPX5 proton messages; ALTEF3 electron flux alert; SUM10R 10 cm radio burst summary).

serialNumber.description: Serial number of the message, a plain integer as text.

issueTime.description: Issue time in UTC as the products write it: year, month abbreviation, day, hour and minute, then UTC.

productKind.description: A watch is elevated risk with uncertain timing, a warning is an event that is occurring, imminent or likely, an alert says a threshold has been crossed, a summary reports what was observed.

headline.description: The headline after the product kind, with the level or threshold.
examples: Geomagnetic Storm Category G4 or Greater Predicted

dayLevels.description: Watch only: the highest storm level predicted for each UTC day.

day.description: Day as month abbreviation and number.

details.description: Labeled lines such as Threshold Reached, Valid From, Valid To, Observed, Synoptic Period, Station, Warning Condition, Active Warning, Supersedes.

value.description: The line value; times in UTC.

noaaScale.description: The NOAA Space Weather Scale level with its name when the message states one; G to Kp, R to X-ray class, S to proton flux.

potentialImpacts.description: Potential impacts by area (Area of Impact, Induced Currents, Spacecraft, Navigation, Radio, Aurora, Radiation); stated as potential effects.

text.description: The stated potential effect at this level.
examples: Possible widespread voltage control problems; some protective systems may mistakenly trip key assets out of the grid.

footer.description: Footer line; keep the exercise statement.
examples: Exercise product. Not an official NOAA message.
